findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "report" is 649 chars, far longer than this server's median (101). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_strategies · Public sink: report, share_report, save_strategy · Destructive: get_prices, build_series, build_signal, simulate, report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_strategies · Public sink: report, share_report, save_strategy · Destructive: get_prices, build_series, build_signal, simulate, report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
